manifest.name: CCFX Shader Pack
manifest.author: CCFX
manifest.description: A collection of CCFX GLSL shader effects and group presets.

effects.name: Sunburst V2
effects.description: Generates an animated radial sunburst with adjustable ray shape and color.

effects.name: Voronoi Cell Pattern
effects.description: Generates evolving Voronoi patterns in several cell styles.

effects.name: Puddle
effects.description: Distorts the image with concentric ripples.

effects.name: Skew V2
effects.description: Skews and tiles the image along a chosen angle.

effects.name: Warp Waves
effects.description: Warps the image with an animated directional wave.

effects.name: Wipe Checker
effects.description: Transitions images with a checkerboard wipe.

effects.name: Wipe Dots
effects.description: Wipes the image with growing or shrinking dots.

effects.name: Wipe Rings
effects.description: Wipes the image with expanding concentric rings.

effects.name: Wipe Stripes
effects.description: Transitions images with an angled stripe wipe.

effects.name: CC Light Sweep
effects.description: Adds a linear or circular light sweep.

effects.name: Lens Flare Lite
effects.description: Generates anamorphic, geometric, or orb lens flares.

effects.name: Plexus V1
effects.description: Creates an animated network of glowing points and lines.

groups.name: MxsterFX Dot BG (By CCFX)
groups.description: Creates a dotted background with a radial wave.

groups.name: MxsterFX Square BG (By CCFX)
groups.description: Creates a tiled square background with a radial wave.

groups.name: Extrude
groups.description: Creates a layered extrusion from the source image.

groups.name: CC Bend It
groups.description: Bends the image between two configurable points.

groups.name: Plexus V2
groups.description: Creates an animated plexus of dots and lines.

groups.name: AE Warp
groups.description: Warps the image with selectable geometric profiles.
